source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: Your boasting about abundance of wealth and children has distracted you from obedience to God.
tafsir.muyassar-2: And you remained busy with that until you reached the graves and were buried in them.
tafsir.muyassar-3: It is not fitting that the competition for wealth should distract you like this. You will soon realize that the Hereafter is better for you.
tafsir.muyassar-4: Then beware: you will soon know the evil outcome of being distracted from it.
tafsir.muyassar-5: It is not fitting that the competition for wealth should distract you like this. If you truly knew with certain knowledge, you would be deterred and would hasten to save yourselves from destruction. You will surely see Hell, then you will surely see it without doubt, then you will surely be asked on the Day of Resurrection about every kind of bounty.
